name: Continue Your Training
summary: In Deathknell, newly risen Forsaken paladins begin their training before setting out for Brill. Aramis Hammerhand sends them east through Tirisfal Glades, where danger and distrust greet those who wield the Holy Light.

sections.title: Leaving Deathknell
sections.body: After learning martial combat and channeling holy power in Deathknell's graveyard, you travel east through Tirisfal Glades to Brill. The town is the regional outpost and administrative hub for central Tirisfal. There, Shari Stilwell oversees the training of those who follow the paladin's path in undeath.

sections.title: A Precarious Calling
sections.body: Aramis warns that an undead paladin's calling is perilous. Lordaeron still needs defenders against threats from beyond, yet wielding the Holy Light under Sylvanas Windrunner's banner invites suspicion. Many Forsaken suffered agony or death at the hands of holy zealots. Among their undead kin, the Light's presence breeds distrust.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand, the paladin trainer in Deathknell, gives this to you.

faq.q: Where do I turn in Continue Your Training?
faq.answer: You bring this to Shari Stilwell, the paladin trainer in Brill, east along the main road from Deathknell.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken distrust paladins?
faq.answer: Many Forsaken resent the Holy Light for the agony it causes undead bodies and for persecution by holy orders such as the Scarlet Crusade. Paladins wield powers many undead fear or despise.

faq.q: Can any Forsaken class take this quest?
faq.answer: No. This is for Forsaken paladins leaving Deathknell for Brill and the wider world.
Brill is a town in central Tirisfal Glades and a hub for Forsaken travelers, guards, and tradesfolk. It lies just north of the Undercity ruins.

faq.q: What threats does Lordaeron face according to Aramis?
faq.answer: Aramis warns that Lordaeron faces rampaging Scourge remnants, hostile wildlife, and vengeful living factions such as the Scarlet Crusade.

angles.text: As an undead paladin, you may find that wielding holy power makes you an outsider among your fellow Forsaken.
As an Undead, you live with tension between loyalty to Lordaeron's soil and the lingering trauma of the Holy Light.
